quotes.text: “The mighty God, even the Lord hath spoken, and called the earth from the rising of the pun unto the going down thereof. Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God hath shined. Our God shall come, and shall not keep silence : afire shall devour before him, and it shall be very tempestuous round about him. He shall call to the heavens from above, and to the earth (that he nmy judge his people).…
